question: To whom does the sovereignty that determines karmic results belong?
premises: The sovereignty that determines results belongs to the supreme Lord alone.
This point has been conclusively established.
The author has elaborated it elsewhere.
inference: The power governing karmic outcomes is the exclusive sovereignty of the supreme Lord, as established in detail elsewhere.
plain_english: That sovereignty belongs to the supreme Lord alone; this has been determined and I have explained it at length elsewhere.
